title: Run an owned CLI process
responsibility: Runs a CLI command with bounded output and time, forwarding complete output lines and supporting cancellation.

inputs.name: killOwnedProcess.pid
inputs.description: The process ID to signal, or undefined to do nothing. On Windows the process itself is targeted; on other platforms the process group with that ID is targeted.

inputs.name: cliProcess.command
inputs.description: The executable name or path and argument array passed directly to spawn. The process runs with the prepared CLI environment and piped standard input, output and error.

inputs.name: cliProcess.options
inputs.description: Optional working directory, stdin text, abort signal, per-line callback, timeout and output byte limit. Defaults are empty stdin, 600000 ms and 16000000 bytes; an already-aborted signal rejects before spawning.

outputs.name: killOwnedProcess
outputs.description: Returns no value. It sends SIGTERM to the target when a truthy PID is supplied and ignores signaling errors.

outputs.name: cliProcess
outputs.description: Resolves to decoded UTF-8 stdout when the process exits with code zero. It rejects on cancellation, timeout, output overflow, process or stdin errors, or nonzero exit; nonzero-exit errors include at most the final 2000 stderr characters.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Rejects with a RunCancelled instance when the supplied signal is already aborted or is aborted while the process runs. Active cancellation also sends SIGTERM to the owned process or process group.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with an Error for timeout, output overflow, nonzero exit, process errors, or stdin errors other than EPIPE. Timeout and output-limit errors have fixed messages; nonzero-exit errors include the exit code and up to the final 2000 stderr characters.
